themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents actively performing research tasks, making decisions, and interacting with data or systems independently.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers AI tools specifically designed to aid researchers in their work, such as literature review, data synthesis, and hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles detailing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, employment, skill requirements, and the labor market.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores AI applications that directly support the design process and user research activities.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discusses platforms and environments that host or facilitate AI research and development.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles comparing, reviewing, and assessing the performance and utility of various AI tools.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Covers research and user experiences related to conversational AI agents, including their capabilities and limitations.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to gather, analyze, and derive actionable insights from customer data and behavior.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
